provenance.personal_reference_note: Personal calibration pairing follows the supplied screenshots. edge case GOOD1/SLOUCH1 and GOOD2/SLOUCH2 show different people at different distances; cross-person baseline replay is not a distance benchmark.
provenance.neutral_warmup: The recorded calibration_reference for each target image
provenance.limitations: 16 user-labeled tuning images in 3 calibration groups. Native CPU inference on repeated still images is not live tracking validation or held-out accuracy. Raw images are not embedded or uploaded.
